title: Mars Rover Image Sparks Alien Civilization Claim
excerpt: A UFO researcher says a Perseverance rover photo shows an ancient Martian doorway, a claim NASA has previously explained as natural rock formations.
content:
UFO researcher Scott C Waring has claimed that a structure in a NASA Perseverance rover image shows evidence of an ancient Mars civilization. The image, captured in late November 2022 with the Mastcam-Z camera, shows a rocky outcrop called Alagnak in Jezero Crater.

Why it matters

The claim revives a recurring pattern in which viral interpretations of rover images are circulated as evidence of extraterrestrial life, even when no definitive proof has been found. Such claims can shape public perception of Mars science, which NASA has consistently addressed by pointing to natural geology.

The central figure is a claimed seven-foot-tall doorway in a panoramic Mastcam-Z image of the Alagnak outcrop, with no independently verified scale reference. Whether the feature is built or natural has not been confirmed, and no definitive proof of extraterrestrial life has been found.

The players

NASA

The National Aeronautics and Space Administration is the U.S. space agency that operates the Perseverance and Curiosity rovers and has repeatedly explained apparent Mars structures as natural geology.

Scott C Waring

Scott C Waring is a UFO researcher who publishes alien-related claims on the UFO Sightings Daily website and has interpreted rover images as evidence of ancient Martian life.

The details

Waring posted his claims on the UFO Sightings Daily website, pointing to a doorway-like shape in an adobe-like building and a bluish-green object he said resembles a fallen statue. Adobe, a sun-dried mudbrick, has been used in human construction for centuries, which Waring cited in support of his interpretation. NASA has previously addressed a similar Curiosity rover doorway image on Mount Sharp, with the Curiosity team attributing it to a natural geologic feature where several linear fractures intersected.

Timeline

  1. Late November 2022: Perseverance rover captured the Alagnak panoramic image.

  2. Last week, relative to publication: Waring posted his alien-structure claims on UFO Sightings Daily.

Roadmap

The Perseverance claim follows the same pattern as the Curiosity doorway image on Mount Sharp, which NASA attributed to natural fractures and pareidolia. It shows how rover photography keeps generating interpretations of Martian structures that have so far been explained by geology rather than life.

Readers evaluating viral Mars images can check whether NASA has published an official explanation before accepting a claim of alien structures. The past Curiosity doorway explanation offers a concrete reference point for judging similar images.

The takeaway

Rover images are often striking, but patterns in rock can look like doors or statues to the human eye. Checking whether an agency has already explained a similar image is a practical way to separate speculation from established geology.
